At the bottom of {wiki:Mintwallin}, the minotaur city, there is a pit guarded by dragons. Go down there and search the fire field north of the room to find a {item:Small Ruby}. It is a daily respawn: only one character can take it per day.
Stairs to the Mintwallin throne room
No minimum level; level 40 recommended (there are dragons).
optional, for the poison fields on the way
It is a {wiki:Daily Respawns|daily respawn}: only one character gets the reward per reset. Go right after the {wiki:Server Save} to have a better chance of being first.

Leave **Thais** through the **north** gate and go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just northwest of that gate. This is where the {wiki:Route:Mintwallin|route to Mintwallin} starts; along the way there are {creature:Minotaur|minotaurs}, {creature:Orc|orcs} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}.
Go down **two floors** and go as far **north** as you can. Then go down one more floor, to the floor of the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}.
Follow this path **east** and then **south** and go down the ladder.
Route to Mintwallin: path to the ladder

On this floor there are many {item:Poison Field|poison fields}. Run through them and cure the poison afterwards, or clear a path with {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field}. Then go down one more floor.
Route to Mintwallin: poison fields floor
Go down through the Cyclops hole
Follow the path **east** and then **north**, careful with the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. Go down the hole marked with a circle on the map: 2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} are waiting for you below.
Route to Mintwallin: the hole marked with a circle
After killing the Cyclopes, follow the maps. There are no more monsters on this path (maybe a {creature:Rat}). On the last map follow the **blue** line, from A to B.
Route to Mintwallin: follow the blue line from A to B
When you reach the two ladders, go down either one and take a few steps **west**: you are at the gate of {wiki:Mintwallin}.
The two ladders to the Mintwallin gate
Go up to the throne room
In Mintwallin head **south** and climb the stairs to the **throne room**.
In the throne room, go down the ladder slightly **southwest** of the stairs. You arrive at the pit, where 1 {creature:Dragon} is waiting for you.
The dragons breathe fire in an area: do not stand in front of them and bring potions.
Go down the hole (open it with the {item:Shovel} if it is closed). Down there are **2 dragons**.
Use *Browse Field* on the fire field to the **north** of the room. Inside is the {item:Small Ruby}. Then leave with the {item:Rope}.
The fire field where the Small Ruby is
Go back to the hole you went down and use the {item:Rope} to climb to the pit. Then climb the ladder to the throne room and go down the stairs back to Mintwallin.

Leave through the Mintwallin gate and do the route in reverse to the {wiki:Ancient Temple} (climb up with the {item:Rope} where needed). On the way back you can use a shortcut: follow the **red** line to a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and then the **blue** line to the exit. From the Ancient Temple you return to Thais through the north gate.
Shortcut back: red line to the Bonelords' hole, then blue line to the exit
The shortcut is one-way only: the hole marked with the red circle drops you down, but there is nowhere to use the Rope, so it can't take you back to Mintwallin.
